=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- Requirement: "Read the default branch at most once per run or tick." (LINKED ISSUE Fix section: "read the default branch at most once per run or tick, and add no per-item calls").
  Expected change site: `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` — the default-branch memo populated by `_autofix_review_default_branch_prime` and consumed by `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs`.
  Evidence of absence: The memo added in the last run is held only in process shell variables (`_AUTOFIX_REVIEW_DEFAULT_BRANCH`, `_AUTOFIX_REVIEW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_STATE`, `_AUTOFIX_REVIEW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_REPO` at `scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1339-1341`), never in a cross-shell file under `RUNTIME_DIR` like the poller's `_review_run_default_branch`. `autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer` is invoked from `scripts/review_autofix_step_post_commit_retrigger.sh:112` and from `scripts/review_autofix_step_changes_lost_redispatch.sh:25`; `autofix_changes_lost_head_retry_consumed` is invoked from `scripts/review_autofix_step_changes_lost_redispatch.sh:52`. The post-commit and changes-lost steps run in separate step shells, so when both step predicates are true (CONFLICT_RESOLVED=true and EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST=true), each shell primes an empty memo and issues its own `GET repos/<repo>`, for two reads in one workflow run. The per-shell memo therefore guarantees at most one read per shell, not per run.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
  Note: this is the sole residual gap and it carries no runtime failure path. The pre-PR code read the default branch on every `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs` call with no memo at all, so this PR is a strict improvement; the marginal second read is one cheap `GET repos/<repo>` only on the rare post-commit + changes-lost overlap, and the issue's hard constraint of "no per-item calls" is satisfied. Prior editor rounds (PR comment entry[10]) already evaluated and deferred this with the same rationale; I am re-reporting it only because it remains the one open item named in the cross-pollination ledger and the issue's verbatim wording is not literally met.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Lines 1339-1341 | severity=high | confidence=4

  WHY: `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs` is executed within subshells (via $()). Because these variables are not exported, they are not inherited by the subshell, causing the function to perform redundant default-branch reads instead of utilizing the intended memoized value. This violates the task requirement to read the default branch at most once per run.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Read the default branch at most once per run or tick" (issue #6629, reusing the #5094 rule the issue extends).
  Expected change site: `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` — the memo in `_autofix_review_default_branch_prime` (lines 1330-1363) used by `autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer` (line 1602) and `autofix_changes_lost_head_retry_consumed` (line 1815).
  Evidence of absence: The memo in `scripts/gh_helpers.sh` lives only in shell variables (`_AUTOFIX_REVIEW_DEFAULT_BRANCH`, `_AUTOFIX_REVIEW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_STATE`, `_AUTOFIX_REVIEW_DEFAULT_BRANCH_REPO`), so it does not cross step shells. The poller's `_review_run_default_branch` already solves the same problem with a file-based memo keyed on `$$` under `${RUNTIME_DIR:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}` (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19456-19478`), and that approach would also work here. When `CONFLICT_RESOLVED=true` and `EDITOR_CHANGES_LOST=true` both hold, `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` runs `review_autofix_step_post_commit_retrigger.sh` (peer check) and `review_autofix_step_changes_lost_redispatch.sh` (retry-budget check) in separate step shells; each starts with an empty memo and calls `gh_retry gh api repos/<repo> --jq .default_branch` once, so the default branch is read twice for the same workflow run. The added `tests/test_retrigger_default_branch_dispatch.py::test_default_branch_is_read_once_per_shell` only exercises the in-shell path (its own docstring reads "the peer check and the retry-budget check run in one step shell") and never reaches the cross-step case. The previous autofix rounds also flagged this gap and explicitly deferred it as `TASK_GAP_DEFERRED: the default branch can be read twice in one review run` (PR comment 6095135202, 2026-10-10T07:30:20Z), so the last run is choosing to ship a per-shell memo instead of the per-run memo the issue specifies. The functional security check is still correct (every matcher's provenance check still holds), so this is a cost-of-API-calls gap rather than a correctness gap, but the issue text is explicit.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
